name: fpl-hsmem
description: Long-term memory across sessions for Claude Code, wrapping a Hindsight server. Recalls relevant history before every prompt and captures the conversation after every response, so decisions stop being re-litigated each session; 27 MCP tools let an agent search memory, browse it by structured filter, correct a wrong fact without destroying the record, and see which background jobs failed. Use when a project runs across more than a few sessions, when memory returns something stale, or when you need to know what was tried and rejected — the code shows what won, never what lost. Ships 3 auto-hooks, 9 skills (status, bootstrap, mental-model, diagnose, export-bank, correct-memory, audit-bank, directives, memory-setup) and the memory-curator agent. v3.4.0: RETRIEVAL-AND-MEMORY.md — which question goes to which layer, and the correction that recorded decisions (ADR/RFC/PRD) live in the repository and are asked BEFORE memory. v3.3.0: audit against the official docs — one version source read at handshake, plugin-scoped skill references, the canonical prompt-defense preamble, hooks in exec form. v3.2.0: MEMORY_WRITE_TOOLS as the single source a CI gate derives agent denylists from. v3.1.0: the server explains itself via MCP `instructions`; bilingual skill descriptions with model tiers. v3.0.0 (breaking): the relay stopped being write-only — memory became correctable; `retain_mission` removed as a tool argument; bank identity anchors on the project root. Full history in CHANGELOG.md.
